Method of Attack: Spamming COVID-19 themed emails with malicious attachments
Malicious document attachment requiring 'Enable Content' to execute PowerShell command
Downloading malware executable saved as a three-digit number in %UserProfile% folder
Executing PowerShell command to download malware
Infecting victim's computer to become part of botnet operation
Downloading and installing additional malware to steal data, passwords, and potentially deploy ransomware
Attack Vector: Spam email with stolen reply-chain emails
Malicious email attachment titled 'EG-8777 Medical report COVID-19.doc' and similar
PowerShell command execution after enabling content in document
Indicators of Compromise: Emails pretending to be from 'California Fire Mechanics' with 'May COVID-19 update'
Downloaded executable named as a three-digit number such as '498.exe' in %UserProfile% folder
